channel.title: Secret Life of Boys
channel.desc: Ginger is worried that she has upset both Ethan and Robbie, and wants to make it right. Robbie feels just as bad and wants to get on the plane to apologise in person. All he has to do is get over his fear of flying, so Chris offers to help him out. Ethan decides to swallow his pride and reach out to Penny, but he botches the video and makes things worse with her. Corey, meanwhile, has found out about Matt?s plan to spend Christmas with Tabitha?s family and is not handling it well. She heads to Matt?s flat to make sure that he comes home. Bob, who is also about to go home, enlists the boys to find a Christmas gift for Corey. He forgot for the second year in a row! Bad Bob.
